docs.purpose: The small form on the placements page that adds one advertiser by name, so an offer can name it (D-3). It is not the parked advertiser accounts list.
docs.data_story: It writes one advertisers row (created active) and one admin_audit_log row through the advertiser contract; a second submit of the same entry writes nothing.
docs.under_126: **GENERATED.** Rendered by the web FORM binding from render.form and advertiser_request in placements-contract.json.

tables: migrations/302_admin_ads_placements.sql — advertisers, placements (Class E, seeded), offers; RLS and the two Admin Placements variables
gate: src/lib/auth/require-admin-page.ts — requireAdminPage(), called first in the page

identity.owner: Admin domain (Spec 126 §14 Target Files) — no individual owner is named by Specs 126/127/128.
spec_refs: docs/specs/02-web-admin/126_maxbld_surface_standard.md §6.3 rows 4-6 dated notes 2026-11-10 — advertisers, placements, offers as built
docs/specs/00-architecture/114_rls_policy_catalog.md §2 dated notes 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-10 — the admin-read pattern (offers, advertisers); placements Class E

versioning.why: Nothing consumes this surface: it does not exist, so no compatibility promise can have been made. It gains one at its C9 cutover, when the golden pair is captured.
evidence: docs/specs/02-web-admin/126_maxbld_surface_standard.md §2.2 — one of the 11 NEW admin surfaces
docs/specs/02-web-admin/127_surface_conversion_procedure.md §4.3 — the golden PAIR pins the shape

inputs.why: The fields come from advertiser_request in placements-contract.json, the schema the advertiser route validates.

outputs.why: The write goes through a declared MUTATION contract and the page waits for the server.
outputs.rollback: None is applied locally, so none is undone.

state.why: A web admin form whose canonical writer is the mutation contract; nothing persists on the device.

staleness.why: Submitted per request; the page re-reads after success.

session.why: An /admin/** page: classifyRoute returns "admin" for any pathname starting with /admin/, and "admin" is the profiles.is_admin flag checked in-predicate, not a Postgres role.
evidence: src/lib/auth/route-guard.ts:159 — /api/admin/ returns "admin" for the contract half
migrations/226_profiles_admin_bootstrap.sql:27 — is_admin BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false
docs/specs/00-architecture/114_rls_policy_catalog.md §2 — there is no admin Postgres role; admin is a column flag checked inside the policy predicate

rls_class.why: The page writes offers and advertisers, Class B by Spec 114 §2 with the ONE ruled admin-read pattern (RLS on, one <table>_select_admin policy, no write policy); MF-40 D-1 (operator 2026-11-10) drops the move to an advertiser class (admin input only). placements, which it reads, is Class E (one public select policy, seed-only). The routes read and write through the owner connection, so the policies are defence in depth.
evidence: docs/specs/00-architecture/114_rls_policy_catalog.md §2 dated notes 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-10 — the admin-read pattern (offers, advertisers); placements Class E
migrations/302_admin_ads_placements.sql — advertisers, placements (Class E, seeded), offers; RLS and the two Admin Placements variables

checks.why: R-12: exactly one admin_audit_log row (advertiser_upsert) per created advertiser, in the same transaction; a repeat submit writes nothing.

errors.why: Every admin route handler is wrapped by withApiEnvelope, which returns { data, error, meta } with a sanitised code on any throw; the surface renders from that envelope.
evidence: src/lib/api/with-api-envelope.ts:27 — withApiEnvelope always returns the { data, error, meta } envelope
src/lib/api/with-api-envelope.ts:40-45 — a PG SQLSTATE becomes DATABASE_ERROR; the raw message is never exposed

classes.ui: Redirect to sign-in — the route guard refuses before the page renders.
Full-page "admin only" block naming the is_admin requirement; no partial data.
Full-width error panel carrying the envelope error.code, with a retry control.
The row that failed to parse renders as a red schema_drift row; the rest still renders.

emits.why: A created advertiser writes one admin_audit_log row (advertiser_upsert).
breadcrumbs: admin_audit_log: action offer_schedule | offer_activate | offer_deactivate | advertiser_upsert, target_uid = offer_id or advertiser_id (text), reason a fixed string per action, old_value/new_value the whitelisted columns (contact fields never)

offers.why: It adds the advertisers an offer names; it renders no sponsored placement.
evidence: docs/specs/02-web-admin/126_maxbld_surface_standard.md §6.3 rows 4-6 dated notes 2026-11-10 — advertisers, placements, offers as built

metering.why: An operator act, not a metered product action.
evidence: docs/specs/02-web-admin/126_maxbld_surface_standard.md §6.3 rows 4-6 dated notes 2026-11-10 — advertisers, placements, offers as built

config.why: No tunable: the name length is a schema bound.

sharing.why: advertisers is read by the offer FORM's advertiser select.
evidence: docs/specs/02-web-admin/126_maxbld_surface_standard.md §6.3 rows 4-6 dated notes 2026-11-10 — advertisers, placements, offers as built
sharing.varies_by_surface: This form adds one advertiser; the offer form lists the active ones.

limitations.what: The admin_audit_log row this surface writes cannot be named in emits.ledger_events[].
limitations.measured: surface.schema.json's emits.ledger_events[] is closed to usage_events events; admin_audit_log is the second append-only ledger with no token, so emits.answer is "ledger" and the audit row is carried in breadcrumbs[] plus a ledger_row_present check (the admin_placements precedent).

notes: MF-40 D-3 (minimal advertisers entry on the placements page, no LIST or DETAIL; admin_advertiser_accounts stays parked). Trim 4: created active, no deactivation or rename in v1. advertiser_id is generated by the page (idempotent create).

programme.why: The advertiser entry of the admin placements page (MF-40 D-3).
